Name: Prince's Background Colors for Farmer Portraits
Author: princelevi
Description:
Hi! This is my first mod and I'm very new to the modding community, so forgive me for any information I don't know or may not be able to give you.

Anyway, Here is my collection of files for Aedenthorn's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11398]Farmer Portraits[/url] mod.

instructions:

1. Download the "Template Content Pack" (as well as the actual mod) from Aedenthorn
2. Unzip the template pack, which should appear in your mods folder as "[CP] Farmer Portrait"
3. Open the assets folder and delete the file named "background"
4. Unzip my file onto your desktop/another place that is easily accessible (not the mods folder) and then select the color you want
5. drag/copy the png into the assets folder and rename it to "background"
6. you're all done! make sure the config of the base mod "Farmer Portraits" has custom backgrounds set to true.

I haven't fully tested all of the photos, so let me know if they look bad or if there are any issues so I can fix it up for you :) I can also add more colors if anyone is interested, but I want to test the waters first.

1.1 Update: There are now two folders, "No Background" and "Starblue". The Starblue files have wooden paneling and will match other Starblue recolor portraits, while the No Backgrounds files will have a transparent background outside the frame. Let me know if there are any recolors you want a background for!

Starblue Valley Recolor by Lita/strangelyliteral: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1869
